lines.zh: 我绕开这片枯林，省翅力。
lines.en: I skirt this dead wood to save my wings.

lines.zh: 我翅上沾着幽匿的孢子。
lines.en: Sculk spores cling to my wings.

lines.zh: 空中没有路标，只有菌丝。
lines.en: No signposts in the air—only mycelium threads.

lines.zh: 再低一点，菌毯就在下面。
lines.en: A little lower—the sculk mat is right below.
The horde wants me to harvest.
Headwind or not, the hive is waiting.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜上，生了一层幽匿。
lines.en: A layer of sculk has grown on my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我翅上的幽匿纹，嗡嗡作响。
lines.en: Sculk veins hum on my wings.

lines.zh: 别往下看，我的菌毯会缠脚。
lines.en: Don't look down; my sculk mat tangles feet.
My wings ache, and there's one more trip.
Beat slower and save some strength.
Who blew my clouds apart?
What I harvest isn't honey — it's sculk.

lines.zh: 我闻到水汽里的腐木味。
lines.en: I smell rotten wood in the damp air.
I hug the wall and keep a low profile.
Fly high, or the sculk block slips.

lines.zh: 幽匿的低语，把话都盖住了。
lines.en: The sculk whisper drowns out the words.
There's a sour rot in the air.
The night is long, and the sculk isn't all moved.
Counting clouds—one, two, three.

lines.zh: 一动也不想动，幽匿质量在涨。
lines.en: I do not want to move; the sculk mass grows.

lines.zh: 这里安静得只剩我的翅声。
lines.en: It's so quiet only my wings sound.
altar has this one perk.
I fold my wings and hang at the hive mouth.
The wind died; beating my wings won't help.
This bee gathers sculk, not nectar.
I perch on the branch, waiting for the wind to turn.

lines.zh: 太阳晃眼，我的菌毯反光。
lines.en: The sun glares off my sculk mat.
A sculk bee with green wings.
I know that hide of yours.
Hold still; let me look at your back.

lines.zh: 别用火把指我，幽匿怕光。
lines.en: Do not point a torch at me, sculk fears light.
The name's Sculk Bee Harvester, remember.
You look easy to bully.
The sculk in my hive is still growing.

lines.zh: 你要上来看看我的巢吗？
lines.en: Would you come up and see my hive?
I don't gather honey; I gather sculk — 幽匿工蜂, look player

lines.zh: 我搬的不是蜜，是幽匿碎块。
lines.en: I haul sculk, not honey.

lines.zh: 翅膀沾了幽匿，还是能振。
lines.en: Sculk on my wings, and they still beat.
You hit me; the base of my wing is numb.
Don't chase; I'll leave on my own.
A fistful of fuzz fell off my wings.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被菌块压住了！
lines.en: A sculk block is pinning my wing!

lines.zh: 背上菌块太重，我飞不稳。
lines.en: The sculk block on my back is too heavy; I wobble.
Thin wing membrane splits at one swat.
That hurt—who struck me?
Twenty health, wings still beating.

lines.zh: 这一下真狠，菌块都掉了。
lines.en: That hit was hard—my sculk block fell.
Any more rotten meat in your bag?

lines.zh: 你手里的腐渣，分我一口。
lines.en: Share a mouthful of the rot in your hand.
I won't snatch; I'll wait for you to drop some.

lines.zh: 我采的不是蜜，是幽匿孢子。
lines.en: What I gather is sculk spores, not honey.

lines.zh: 烤肉的香气勾着我的翅。
lines.en: The smell of roast meat tugs at my wings.
Let me land and rest a moment.
Wherever you walk, my shadow follows.
Give it to me and I'll obey.
Steady your hand; the pollen will spill.
Twenty hit points, gone at a touch.
Why is this wall moving at me?
You bumped me on purpose, didn't you?
Who hit me? The sculk block shattered!

lines.zh: 我的搬运路线被谁改了？
lines.en: Who changed my carrying route?
Twenty points. One bump and I wobble.

lines.zh: 我这副薄翅，是幽匿丝织的。
lines.en: These thin wings are woven of sculk.
In this sky there is only me and you.
Let me through; I'm carrying a load.
Sorry, the sculk block blocked my eyes.
My wings hit the stone wall; let me by.
Do not be shy, lift your head.
My hive is built of sculk.
The wind is right; let's haul this load together.
Come closer and look at my sculk block.

lines.zh: 最稳的那根枝，我留给你。
lines.en: I've saved the steadiest branch for you.

lines.zh: 我在这棵枯树上守了整季。
lines.en: I have guarded this dead tree a whole season.
I harvest this sculk bloom first.

lines.zh: 你飞得真好看，翅膀很稳。
lines.en: You fly beautifully; your wings are steady.
Wings open—look at the sculk on my back.
I carry pollen back to the sculk hive.
I've got it firmly; it won't drop.

lines.zh: 我这副翅膀薄，飞起来嗡嗡响。
lines.en: These wings are thin and buzz in flight.
I hide it under my wings.

lines.zh: 这块拿给巢里的伙伴看。
lines.en: I'll show this to my hive mates.
This sculk is useful; I'll take it.
Tuck it in my claws and make another trip.
This one — I saw it first.
Another piece for the nest.
This one is heavy; I fly low.
This color—could it trade for something?
What I harvest isn't flowers.
Today's sculk will feed the whole hive.
Don't look up. Too late.
I'm truly hungry; my wings feel weak.
I count to three, then dive.
I've locked on; don't run.

lines.zh: 你走进菌毯，就无处可躲。
lines.en: Step onto the sculk mat and there's nowhere to hide.
Dropping from above is fastest.

lines.zh: 工蜂飞出去，就不会空手回。
lines.en: A harvester never returns empty.
I'll save this mouthful for the larvae.
Now—the hive is short of workers.
I harvest sculk, not honey.
These worker wings harvest sculk.

lines.zh: 我飞得比你快，背着货也是。
lines.en: I'm faster than you, even carrying cargo.

lines.zh: 我这工蜂，只采幽匿孢子。
lines.en: This harvester bee gathers only sculk spores.
Hide in a hole—I can squeeze in too.
I skim the trunk to dodge the wind.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，看看哪里松动。
lines.en: I circle once to see where it's loose.

lines.zh: 幽匿的翅膀追得有点吃力。
lines.en: These sculk wings are struggling to keep up.

lines.zh: 你绕到树后，我也压过去。
lines.en: You circle behind the tree; I bank after you.

lines.zh: 你听见的嗡声，是我背着货。
lines.en: That hum you hear is me carrying a load.
I'm hovering over your head.

lines.zh: 前面是幽匿墙，我过不去。
lines.en: A sculk wall ahead; I cannot pass.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着地面飞。
lines.en: I drop low and skim the ground.
Hit it. The wing membrane buzzes!
These claws are unclipped and grip hard.
Whew, the load sits steady now.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，把菌粉扬你脸上。
lines.en: One wingbeat throws sculk dust in your face.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的幽匿，已经长满了。
lines.en: Sculk has grown all over my wings.
Run now—I'm already here.
My wings are grown from sculk.
Get down and stop crushing my cargo.

lines.zh: 让开，不然我连你一起搬。
lines.en: Move, or I'll haul you along too.
Taste these wings.
Over the sculk mat, my wings are loud.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，就看见菌毯。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the sculk mat.
My wings aren't open yet—wait.
There's wind—I can fly and haul.

lines.zh: 二十点血，也不耽误我采。
lines.en: Twenty health doesn't stop me gathering.
I've claimed this sky for the hive.
My runes is still here.
I stumbled, but the sculk block held.

lines.zh: 天这么黑，正适合我搬货。
lines.en: So dark—perfect for me to haul cargo.

lines.zh: 翅膀上沾着深绿的孢子。
lines.en: Dark green spores cling to my wings.
The fire caught, and my wings smoke.
I'm falling and my wings won't answer.
Water is pouring in—pull me up.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻我，菌块满天飞。
lines.en: The blast flips me; sculk blocks fly everywhere.
An arrow split my wing membrane.
Magic is ringing inside me.

lines.zh: 饿得飞不动，菌也搬不了。
lines.en: Too hungry to fly, let alone haul sculk.
One lightning strike and my wings go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的翅膀没声音。
lines.en: In the void, my wings make no sound.
